statuses.implemented: safe-docx performs the named bounded operation and element-specific executable evidence is listed
statuses.preservation-only: safe-docx retains the sampled markup without claiming its revision semantics
statuses.conformance-gap: the sampled behavior is executable but does not implement complete ECMA-376 semantics
statuses.non-goal: safe-docx makes no claim for this operation

operationSemantics.comparison: whether comparison authors the record from an original/revised pair
operationSemantics.reconstruction: whether an already-present equal record survives reconstruction

storyScope.leanClaim: Lean checks text and field-marker projections through ins, del, moveFrom, and moveTo in fixed stories and in-place mode. It does not prove advanced-record semantics, snapshots, pairing, annotations, relationships, or rebuild behavior.

records.notes: Comparison authors ordinary content revisions in both modes. Equal pre-existing wrappers survive in-place reconstruction but rebuild resolves them.
Emission is limited to supported run-formatting mutations; semantic comparison and mode preservation are not claimed.
The paragraph-mark parent context is exercised separately; no primitive authors this context.
Emission is limited to supported paragraph-layout mutations.
Generated moves are supported in both modes. Equal pre-existing wrappers survive in-place but are resolved by rebuild; Lean checks projected text only.
Emission and start/end balancing are tested, but wrapper-to-range identity and full pairing semantics remain gaps.
Metadata and the XSD-declared numPr/fldChar parents are validated; semantic resolution and emission are absent.
Metadata is recognized and tblGridChange placement is checked; neither record is semantically resolved.
Existing records are tolerated and retained by ordinary accept/reject, but topology semantics are not applied.
Accept/reject preserves these markers and validates balanced IDs. In-place preserves sampled equal markers; rebuild removes them.
These records have their own normative sections. Preservation does not prove bookmark, comment, permission, or proofing semantics. Rebuild drops proofErr.
w14 conflict records are Microsoft extensions, not ECMA-376 Part 1 denominator entries. The sampled mode difference is recorded without a semantic claim.
Package load/save preserves these parts, but package-wide accept/reject does not sweep them and Lean does not read them. Comparison mode behavior is not claimed here.
